subject: business-studies
title: External Stretch Adventure
welcome_lead: Exam-style stretch. Evaluate competition, recession responses and global influences.
meta_desc: GCSE Business Studies stretch — evaluating competition, recession, and global pressures on UK firms.
final_note: You can evaluate competitive pressures, recession responses and global influences on firms.

concepts.def: Rival firms targeting the same customers
Two quarters of negative economic growth
World trade and culture becoming more linked
Tax on imports raising their price
Government payment to lower business costs
Group lobbying firms to change behaviour

walkthroughs.body_html:
More rivals = downward pressure on prices and margins.

Firms respond by differentiating (USP), improving quality, lowering costs, or finding niches.
Demand falls in a recession. Firms cut costs (delay hiring, reduce stock), focus on cash flow, and target value-conscious customers.

Globalisation offers bigger markets but also tougher competition and currency risk.

Tariffs and subsidies can swing the playing field overnight.
